steps.en: Copy the env file and add a model-provider key
steps.zh: 复制环境文件，填入模型提供商密钥

steps.en: Start the API and the web UI together
steps.zh: 一起拉起 API 和 Web 界面

steps.en: Serves the UI on :3000 and the API on :8000
steps.zh: 在 :3000 提供界面，在 :8000 提供 API

steps.en: Walk the company onboarding wizard in the browser
steps.zh: 在浏览器里走完公司入职向导

steps.en: Writes company/profile.yaml and seeds the local vector index
steps.zh: 写出 company/profile.yaml，并灌入本地向量索引

steps.en: Ask an executive question in chat or on Slack
steps.zh: 在聊天或 Slack 里问一个高管问题

steps.en: Calls specialists in parallel and answers in one executive voice
steps.zh: 并行咨询专家，再用同一个高管声音作答

value.en: You deploy an app and onboard a company profile; you get one executive voice that remembers decisions, not eight agents to wire yourself
value.zh: 你部署一个应用并录入公司档案，换来一个记得决策的高管声音，而不是自己去接八个 agent

sources: https://github.com/SenteLabsAI/OpenExecutive/blob/main/README.md Quick Start (cp .env.example .env, make dev, http://localhost:3000, API :8000 / UI :3000)
https://github.com/SenteLabsAI/OpenExecutive/blob/main/Makefile (dev recipe: uvicorn :8000 and npm run dev)
https://github.com/SenteLabsAI/OpenExecutive/blob/main/docs/architecture.md (Executive orchestrator, parallel specialist calls, company/profile.yaml, ChromaDB seed, Slack)
